goal_checks.notes: TestRunContext_SurvivesParentCancel, _OwnTimeout, _OwnCancel all pass — confirms the three invariants §7.5 requires.
TestHubSubscribe_ReplayAfterSeq and _RingBufferEviction confirm topic-per-RunID, seq assignment, and bounded ring-buffer replay.

TestHubPublish_SlowSubscriberDropped confirms Publish drops a full subscriber (closes its channel, removes it) rather than blocking; the test itself would hang past its 1s timeout if Publish blocked, and it completes immediately.
TestHubSubscribe_UnsubscribeStopsDelivery (incl. double-unsubscribe) and TestHubClose_ClosesAllSubscribers (incl. double-close) both pass.

All 10 hub_test.go tests pass under plain go test. Originally the -race requirement could not be satisfied in this environment (CGO_ENABLED=0, no C compiler). Resolved 2026-09-14: installed a C toolchain (scoop install gcc, nuwen mingw-w64 15.2.0), set CGO_ENABLED=1, and reran. `go test -race ./internal/pipeline/...` (7 hub tests + 3 RunContext tests) and `go test -race ./...` (whole module, all packages) both pass with zero races reported. Manual review from the earlier pass still stands as corroboration: every field the Hub/topic mutate (topics map, seq, buf, subs, nextSubID) is guarded by h.mu or t.mu for every access path; channel sends use select/default so Publish never blocks holding t.mu.
